usage: The word 涼 (leong4) is used to describe a temperature that is pleasantly cool, neither hot nor cold.
It can describe the weather, a breeze, or even a drink that makes you feel refreshed.
涼 (leong4) is mostly used as an adjective and comes before the noun it describes.
You can also use it to say how you feel, for example, saying your room or drink is cool.
It is a common word to express mild coolness in daily conversation.
